score_methods.simple_logistic: StandardScaler and LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=1000, random_state=20260926)

threshold_candidates: up to 501 fixed empirical training-score quantiles from 0 to 1 plus an always-silent threshold; no validation-score-derived thresholds
threshold_pick_on_train: maximize matched evaluable proxy events subject to the named training false-alarm budget; tie: fewer background false alerts, fewer duplicate or unmatched positive-window alerts, then higher score threshold
fresh_alarm: score >= threshold and (previous eligible minute is not adjacent or was below threshold)
event_match: each new alert matches the earliest unmatched evaluable event with onset > alert time and <= alert time + 360 s
background_denominator: negative eligible minute windows / 60 hours; false starts only on negative eligible windows; unmatched new starts inside positive windows are reported separately
interpretation: Internal development comparison of future sensor crossing, not final selected model, independent hazard truth, or coke-plant accident prediction.
